artifacts.summary: Documents the terminal-write enforcement scope boundary (RECOVERY_DECLINED detection is the sole enforcement on the /orchestrate direct-dispatch path; no SubagentStop-level prevention covers it) across three existing source-store files, with no edits to the agent contract, the detector, or the handoff-staleness gate.

completion_data.completion_summary: Added a single authoritative subsection to handoff-schema.md's Outcome Channels stating that RECOVERY_DECLINED detection is the sole, detection-only enforcement of a dispatched agent's terminal .return-meta.json write on the /orchestrate direct-dispatch path, plus one-sentence pointers to it in skill-lifecycle.md and system-defect-discrimination.md. No contract, detector, or test file was edited; the handoff-staleness gate is unchanged.

memory_candidates.content: verify-deploy.sh's TARGET argument must be the repo root (containing both .claude/ and agent-system/extensions/), never a source-store subtree like agent-system/extensions/core -- the latter has no deployed .claude tree of its own and the script errors with 'no deploy tree at <TARGET>/.claude'. When a plan's Tier Justification names a scoped gate invocation, verify the TARGET argument resolves before trusting it literally.

agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/generate-context-line-counts.sh (the index-entries.json line_count repair tool) must be invoked from the DEPLOYED copy (.claude/scripts/generate-context-line-counts.sh), never the source-store copy -- the source-store copy refuses to run because its relative '../..' repo-root resolution is bogus from that location. It performs a surgical, line-oriented awk substitution touching only line_count fields, so it is safe to run even while sibling tasks hold other uncommitted edits to index-entries.json.

A plan verification step that greps for an exact multi-word phrase inserted as prose (not as a heading) can silently fail if the prose naturally line-wraps across that phrase at ~100 chars -- grep -n matches single lines only. When adding a pointer sentence that must grep-match a heading's exact text, reflow the sentence so the full quoted phrase stays on one line, even if that line exceeds the usual prose wrap width.
